ztb.trading.environment.components.position_manager module

Position Manager - Handles position management for the trading environment.

This module separates position-related logic from the main environment class, including execution of trades, trade accounting, and position state tracking.

class ztb.trading.environment.components.position_manager.PositionManager(config: Any, get_price_callback: Callable[[], float])[source]

Bases: object

Manages trading positions including opening, closing, and PnL calculation.

This class handles: - Position opening and closing - Entry and exit cost calculation - Realized and unrealized PnL tracking - Trade counting and consecutive trade tracking

execute_action(action: int, current_step: int, min_holding_period: int = 0) → float[source]

Execute trading action.

allow_reverse=True (default): Traditional behavior

  • SELL from Long: Close→immediately Short

  • BUY from Short: Close→immediately Long

allow_reverse=False: No reversal mode

  • SELL from Long: Close only (back to Flat)

  • BUY from Short: Close only (back to Flat)

  • SELL/BUY from Flat: Opens normally

Parameters:

  • action – Action to execute (0=HOLD, 1=BUY, 2=SELL)

  • current_step – Current step number

  • min_holding_period – Minimum steps to hold position before reversal (prevents allow_reverse during this period)

Returns:

PnL from this specific trade INCLUDING entry fees (negative for new positions)

Return type:

trade_pnl

open_position(direction: int, current_step: int) → float[source]

Open position (entry cost immediately reflected).

🔧 CRITICAL FIX: 少額取引対応 - 実口座では1 mBTC (0.001 BTC ≈ 18,000円) 程度の少額取引が必要 - max_position_size は理想的なサイズだが、資金不足の場合は利用可能資金で調整 - これにより、資金がmax_position_size分に満たなくても取引可能になる

Parameters:

  • direction – Position direction (+1 for Long, -1 for Short)

  • current_step – Current step number

Returns:

Entry cost (fee paid to open position)

close_position(current_step: int | None = None) → float[source]

Close current position.

Parameters:

current_step – Current step number (optional, for trade tracking)

Returns:

Realized PnL from closing the position

calculate_unrealized_pnl() → float[source]

Calculate unrealized PnL for current open position.

Realized PnL is accumulated in close_position(). This method only returns unrealized PnL for reward calculation.

Returns:

Unrealized PnL (price change only, no exit cost yet)

get_position_info() → dict[str, Any][source]

Get current position information.

Returns:

Dictionary with position details

reset() → None[source]

Reset position state.

ztb.trading.environment.components.reward_calculator module

Reward Calculator - Handles reward calculation logic for trading environment.

This module separates the complex reward calculation logic from the main environment class.

class ztb.trading.environment.components.reward_calculator.RewardCalculator(config: Any, reward_settings: RewardSettings, initial_portfolio_value: float)[source]

Bases: object

Calculates rewards for trading actions with curriculum learning stages.

This class encapsulates all reward-related logic including: - Curriculum learning stages (forced_balance, balanced_transition, etc.) - Profit bonuses and loss penalties - Position penalties - Drawdown, stagnation, growth, and win streak calculations

get_setting_int(key: str, default: int) → int[source]

Get integer reward setting with fallback.

get_setting_float(key: str, default: float) → float[source]

Get float reward setting with fallback.

get_setting_bool(key: str, default: bool) → bool[source]

Get boolean reward setting with fallback.

calculate_reward(action: int, current_price: float, position: float, portfolio_value: float, atr: float, transaction_cost: float, reward_scaling: float, pnl: float, old_position: float, step: int, observation: Any | None, reward_history: List[float], portfolio_value_history: List[float]) → float[source]

Calculate reward with curriculum learning stages.

Parameters:

  • action – Action taken (0=HOLD, 1=BUY, 2=SELL)

  • current_price – Current market price

  • position – Current position

  • portfolio_value – Current portfolio value

  • atr – Average True Range

  • transaction_cost – Transaction cost

  • reward_scaling – Reward scaling factor

  • pnl – Profit/Loss from action

  • old_position – Position before action

  • step – Current step number

  • observation – Current observation (for feature access)

  • reward_history – History of rewards

  • portfolio_value_history – History of portfolio values

Returns:

Calculated reward value

calculate_drawdown_penalty(reward_history: List[float]) → float[source]

Calculate drawdown penalty (when drawdown exceeds 50%).

calculate_stagnation_penalty(portfolio_value_history: List[float]) → float[source]

Calculate stagnation penalty (when portfolio isn’t growing).

calculate_growth_bonus(portfolio_value_history: List[float]) → float[source]

Calculate growth bonus (when portfolio is increasing).

calculate_win_streak_bonus(reward_history: List[float]) → float[source]

Calculate win streak bonus.

reset() → None[source]

Reset internal state.

calculate_reward_simple(pnl: float, portfolio_value: float, position: float, old_position: float, action: int = 0, reward_history: List[float] | None = None, portfolio_value_history: List[float] | None = None) → float[source]

Sharpe ratio-based reward function for better risk-adjusted performance.

This reward function considers: 1. Risk-adjusted returns (Sharpe-like ratio) 2. Position sizing efficiency 3. Trading frequency balance 4. Drawdown control

Parameters:

  • pnl – Profit/Loss from action (in currency units)

  • portfolio_value – Current portfolio value

  • position – Current position size

  • old_position – Position before action

  • action – Action taken (0=HOLD, 1=BUY, 2=SELL)

  • reward_history – History of rewards

  • portfolio_value_history – History of portfolio values

Returns:

Risk-adjusted reward in range [clip_min, clip_max]

test_reward_calculation() → None[source]

Test reward calculation with sample inputs.
